text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: On one of my days off...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even though we don't have training<n>scheduled,
Taiki Shuttle drops by my<n>office.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yessiree! Actually, my good pals<n>Suzuka and
Fukukitaru are competing<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I came to see if ya wanna watch the<n>race with me
on TV and cheer 'em<n>on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Got any carrot juice on hand? We<n>can use it to
celebrate if either of 'em<n>win!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Taiki and I sit down to watch the race<n>together...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka has stolen the lead<n>with her
runaway style—the gap<n>continues to widen as she
speeds<n>down the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This race has become hers alone!<n>She crosses the
finish line, the<n>competition ten lengths behind!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that was fantastic! Way to go,<n>Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she won a graded<n>race by such a
huge margin...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka's been doin' amazing ever<n>since she came
back from Hong<n>Kong! That's her fourth win in a
row!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
As her friend, I couldn't be happier!<n>I'm gonna give
her a big hug once<n>she gets back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka has taken on numerous<n>challenges in
search of her own<n>unique running style.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It looks like she's finally found her<n>answer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzuka won! This calls for a party!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After such a memorable race, one<n>thing is for
sure—we can't afford to<n>take our eyes off of
Silence Suzuka.
